meta.source: Rebrand 2026-10-07: white, black and strawberry (Apple's Strawberry, #FF2F92); Unbounded for display, Geist for text. Supersedes the paper/earth/air palette and the two serifs, which the books and Notes keep. The mark reads Soft Heart (strawberry) above Strong Hands (black).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: white by day, black at night.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Second ground: alternating sections, quiet panels, the icon tile.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised sheet: cards, labels, inputs. Separated by rule, never by shadow.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders. Decorative strength (1.3:1 day, 1.5:1 night).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, paper-2 and card (19:1 or better in both themes). Also the Strong Hands half of the seal.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, nav, specs on labels (9:1 or better on every ground).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, placeholders (6:1 or better on every ground).

tokens.name: heart
tokens.usage: The signature: Apple's Strawberry. Button fills, the hero phrase, the horizon, the mark on product, the Soft Heart half of the seal. As text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (3.5:1 on white; 5.7:1 on black). Small text uses heart-ink.

tokens.name: heart-ink
tokens.usage: Strawberry for small text: links, eyebrows, badges, the current nav item, hover of a heart fill (5.7:1 on white, 5.0:1 on heart-tint; 6.9:1 on black, 5.8:1 on night heart-tint).

tokens.name: heart-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind heart-ink text: badges, selected rows, the label band, text selection.

tokens.name: on-heart
tokens.usage: Text on a heart fill: black in both themes (6:1). Never white on strawberry at text sizes.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: The deep surface: the sign-up and contact sections and the footer. Black by day, true black at night. Always paired with on-deep.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep (19:1+). Links on deep use heart-ink's night value.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions only. Orange-red, so it is never mistaken for the strawberry (4.9:1 on white, 8:1 on black).

tokens.name: bent-paper
tokens.usage: The Bent One imprint: page paper.

tokens.name: bent-page
tokens.usage: The Bent One: backdrop behind the page.

tokens.name: bent-ink
tokens.usage: The Bent One: story text.

tokens.name: bent-red
tokens.usage: The Bent One: the bent line, its icon and focus colour (5.6:1 on bent-paper).

tokens.name: bent-ochre
tokens.usage: The Bent One: art only.

tokens.name: bent-water
tokens.usage: The Bent One: water in the art (5.2:1).

tokens.name: bent-glow
tokens.usage: The Bent One: window glow in the art.

tokens.name: mia-paper
tokens.usage: Mia, the Sun, and the Moon: caption-card paper.

tokens.name: mia-ink
tokens.usage: Mia: story text on mia-paper (13.1:1).

tokens.name: mia-ember
tokens.usage: Mia: CTA fill and kicker. 4.1:1 on mia-paper: as text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: mia-blush
tokens.usage: Mia: selection on day pages.

tokens.name: mia-sun
tokens.usage: Mia: the sun in the mark. Art only.

tokens.name: mia-dusk
tokens.usage: Mia: night pages.

tokens.name: mia-moonlight
tokens.usage: Mia: the moon in the mark; text on mia-dusk.

families.bookText: "Source Serif 4", "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, Georgia, serif

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Soap, books and software. Made in Florida.
styles.usage: The hero statement, clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 4rem). Weight 800; the last phrase in heart. A fact, not a motto.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Two Picture Books, Free to Read

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and craft titles. Unbounded is wide: keep card titles short.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The full name beside the mark in the header (web), the comma in heart. On product the name is always the SHSH lockup.

styles.name: label-name
styles.usage: Scent or product name on a soap label, in the band's tint.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Cold-process soap, made in small batches in Florida. Not for sale yet; the first bars are planned for late 2026.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under a title, ink-soft.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two short children's books, written for my kids and my nephew, free to read in English and Spanish.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Not for sale yet; the first bars are planned for late 2026.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation, UPPERCASE, ink-soft; heart-ink when current.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Label above a section title, UPPERCASE, heart-ink.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges in the exact vocabulary. heart-ink on heart-tint; the quiet tone is ink-soft on paper-2.

styles.name: label-kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase line under the lockup on a label (print size).

styles.name: label-spec
styles.usage: Weight, ingredients and maker line on a label (print size). Nothing on a label goes smaller.

styles.name: mia-title
styles.usage: Mia cover title (Fraunces with SOFT 70, WONK 1). 48px mobile. The books keep their serifs.

styles.name: story
styles.sample: For Mia and Dario, with all my love
styles.usage: Story text on a caption card. 18px mobile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; between a label's lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between siblings.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; header height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding, mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding, desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, the icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and labels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons: pills.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: Only for a physical object shown on screen: a label mockup, a book page. UI uses rule, not shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.
